newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers bonds, certificates for auction.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers bonds, certificates for auction.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will issue three, five, 10 and 30-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) and seven year floating rate certificates (CCT) at its regular end-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement said it would offer:
* Third tranche 1/1/97 3-yr BTPs paying a 6.0 percent coupon.
* First tranche 1/1/97 5-yr BTPs paying 6.25 percent coupon.
* Fifth tranche 1/1/97 10-yr BTP paying a 6.75 percent coupon.
* Third tranche 1/11/96 30-yr BTP paying a 7.25 percent coupon.
* Seventh tranche 1/1/97 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 3.45 pct coupon.
The amount of paper offered will be announced on February 24.
Subscriptions for the CCT, 10-year and 30-year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT on February 27.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT February 28
